profile.reading:
This row records Altia's data centre at Vigo, in the province of Pontevedra in Galicia, north western Spain. The mapped point falls on Estrada de Marcosende, in the Marcosende area of the parish of Zamans within the municipality of Vigo, postcode 36310, close to the University of Vigo campus. Altia does not publish a street address for the building, so the location recorded here comes from the map object rather than from the operator, and this registry does not assert a postal address for it.

What Altia does publish about the site is brief. The company describes the Vigo data centre as occupying about 2,500 square metres of its own floor space and as one of four data centres it operates, all interconnected with each other so that workloads can move between them. That interconnection is the basis of the disaster recovery as a service and remote backup products the company sells, alongside managed cloud, private cloud on dedicated hardware, SAP HANA Cloud deployment, internet transit, virtual private networking, perimeter security and round the clock systems monitoring, all offered under service level guarantees whose numeric targets are not published. Altia holds SAP Certified Partner status both in hosting services and in cloud and infrastructure services.

No electrical figure of any kind is published for the Vigo building. Altia gives no utility service size, no IT load, no generator or UPS rating, no PUE and no tier or resilience certification specific to this site, and none should be inferred from the size figure. Altia does not appear in PeeringDB as a facility operator, so there is no independent carrier side record of the building.

Altia Consultores was founded in 1994 and describes itself today as a group of more than 4,200 people working across 10 countries from more than 30 locations, listed on Spain's BME Growth market and forming part of the IBEX Growth Market All Share index, with NOESIS, BILBOMATICA and NAVEIA among its group companies. It sells strategic and technology consulting, application development, low code delivery, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud and data centre services into banking, insurance, defence, education, energy, healthcare, retail, public sector and transport and logistics customers.

The map record is very new. The OpenStreetMap way was created on 25 June 2026 by a Spanish mapper whose changeset comment says the Altia Datacenter building was being created, with the name, the operator tag and the data centre tag all added in that first version. Nothing in the object predates that edit, so the row rests on a single recent local mapping contribution corroborated by the operator's own description of a Vigo facility.
profile.research_note: Rewritten 2026-09-05. Removed the es.wikipedia.org citations, a banned source for this registry, which had been listed twice, and with them the corporate detail that rested only on them (incorporation date of 17 March 1994 in A Coruna, the June 2016 headquarters move to Calle Vulcano 3 in Oleiros, the 1 December 2010 MAB listing date, and named customers Abanca and Vodafone). Replaced with the operator's own about page, which gives founding since 1994, 4,200 people, 10 countries, more than 30 locations, BME Growth listing inside the IBEX Growth Market All Share, and the NOESIS, BILBOMATICA and NAVEIA group companies. Note the headcount has moved: the prior page said more than 3,200 professionals in 7 countries, the operator now publishes 4,200 in 10 countries. Location established by Nominatim reverse geocode of the stored coordinates, which returns Estrada de Marcosende, Marcosende, Zamans, Vigo, Pontevedra 36310, near the university campus. The operator publishes no address for the site, so none is asserted. PeeringDB facility search for Altia returns nothing. OSM provenance: way 1532398543 created 2026-06-25 by mapper Vermu in changeset 184604344, comment se crea el edificio de Altia Datacenter, single version. WebSearch quota exhausted this session.
